subject: Final billing and tax details for renewal / end-of-term true-up
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@clinicare.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: End-of-term final invoice / PO and VAT info

Hi Logan / Monica,

We're preparing the final closeout for our Redwood contract (renewal effective 2028-01-01). Finance needs the final invoice(s) and a short statement showing how the true-up was calculated so our AP team can book and route the PO. A few asks: 

- Can Redwood split the final amount into two invoices by legal entity (Redwood Inc. USD for Hosting; Redwood EU SAS EUR for EU-resident VAT reconciliation)? We need separate invoices for internal ledger and VAT treatment.
- Please provide Redwood's EU tax certificate / VAT registration for cross-charge (if available) and the vendor TIN you expect on the invoice.
- We have a PO ready — attaching Clinicare_PO_789.pdf. AP wants the invoice to reference PO 789 exactly.
- Our preferred payment is a single EUR wire to the Redwood EU account; if Redwood requires a USD remittance, let us know the equivalent and wire instructions.

We'd like to close this by next week (target payment week of Nov 15). Can you send the invoice and confirmation of bank details?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
CFO, Clinicare S.p.A.
attachments: Clinicare_PO_789.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T10:15:00-05:00
Subject: Re: End-of-term final invoice / PO and VAT info

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the PO. Looping in Karthik from billing to draft the split invoices and confirm tax docs. Quick clarifications so we produce the right artifacts: 

- Is Clinicare able to accept a two-tranche payment (70% on receipt of final invoice, 30% 30 days after) or do you need a single settlement? If AP prefers single wire, we can prioritize that.
- For the EU VAT treatment: do you expect Redwood to issue an invoice with reverse-charge (no VAT) or a VAT-included invoice to the EU entity? Your AP's preference will determine which legal entity issues which invoice.

We will produce: 1) an itemized final invoice referencing PO 789, 2) a one-page true-up calculation showing usage vs committed spend, and 3) the Redwood EU VAT registration / TIN.

Karthik — can you take point on draft invoices and attach the tax cert? Monica — flag if any discounts/credits from the renewal were applied that need to be reflected.

Best,
Logan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
